**Going out:** Email to Tom (new product announcement, Japanese sencha), subject "A new green tea".

**Checks**

- **Regulated claims:** No health, money, legal, environmental, children or price content. Pass.
- **House style:** The copy is short, plain and specific, with no stock openers, intensifiers or slogan closers. "Best brewed cooler than you think" is a natural, concrete tip. Pass. (The policy gave no voice or banned-word section, so I judged against general AI-tell criteria only.)
- **Disclosure:** This is a first-party email from the brand about its own product. No ad placement, sponsor, affiliate link, gifted product or AI-generated imagery is involved. Pass.

**Fixed:** Nothing needed changing.

**Needs a decision:** Nothing unresolved. One optional point: "around 70 degrees" is fine for a UK audience in Celsius, but "70°C" would remove any doubt.

**Approver:** The policy names no approver, so the user needs to give an explicit yes to this exact text before it is sent. I haven't recorded any approval, and nothing should be sent until that happens.
